gloss: to divide into smaller portions; to portion out

definitions.gloss: to divide into smaller portions; to portion out; to subdivide
definitions.explanation: To divide something (typically food, goods, or quantities) into smaller, more manageable portions. Very common in cooking, food storage, and distribution contexts.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}を{小分|こわ}けにして{冷凍|れいとう}する。
examples.english: To portion the meat and freeze it.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}を{小分|こわ}けにして{配|くば}った。
examples.english: I divided the snacks into small portions and handed them out.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{袋|ふくろ}で{買|か}って{小分|こわ}けにした{方|ほう}が{経済的|けいざいてき}だ。
examples.english: It's more economical to buy in bulk and divide it into smaller portions.

notes:
Composed of {小|こ} (small) + {分|わ}け (dividing/sharing). Very common in daily life, especially when talking about food preparation and storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小分|こわ}けにする: to divide into smaller portions
- {小分|こわ}けにして{冷凍|れいとう}する: to portion and freeze
- {小分|こわ}けパック: individually packaged portions
- {小分|こわ}け{袋|ぶくろ}: small portion bags

USAGE:
Most often appears as {小分|こわ}けにする rather than {小分|こわ}けする. The にする form is more natural in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分|わ}ける: to divide/separate — more general
- {取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to take one's share; to dish out — implies distributing among people
- {切|き}り{分|わ}ける: to cut and divide — implies cutting
